title: Why one awkward moment beats 10 compliments 😬 #shorts
description:
You got ten compliments today. Guess which moment your brain replays tonight. 😬 Psychologists call it the negativity bias: across many areas of life, bad tends to be stronger than good.

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/fN20EY-EMLk

#psychology #overthinking #shorts
